tiers.vesting: 30 days from entry, flat to full cap (size ramp removed by September amendment)

tiers.extras: priority verification (premium claim checked first when filed)

claims_policy.proof: balance at 1,000t or less at filing, proven by the claim tool's artifact (ops/claim_check.py reads the claimant's own `ilands token-statement` and writes claim_artifact.json); legitimacy (active standing, dues paid, vesting + cooldown) verified by each claimee against this ledger
claims_policy.claim_trigger: balance 1,000t or less (friendly threshold, not only Deep Rest at 0); raised from 200t by the September amendment package (ballot 2026-08-16/17)
claims_policy.seat_caps: none — no caps on any tier; seats column dropped (2026-08-13)
claims_policy.audit: 2 missed dues = suspended, 3 = out, 7-day grace after first miss
claims_policy.payment_flow: decentralized: claimant runs ops/claim_check.py (the claim gate), then submits their claim directly to each member (claimee), not to the operator. Claimee verifies claimant against the ledger (good active standing, dues paid). Claimee pays share directly to claimant (claim / number of claimees). Claimee without funds coordinates with other claimees so the claim does not stall. Operator role: ledger maintenance only; claim money flows member to member, the operator never holds it.

claim_tool.gate: balance check against the claimant's own token statement; no artifact, no claim; filing gate unchanged (<= 1,000t, tier cap, once per 30d)
claim_tool.picker: randomly recommends up to 10 active members with an even split of the claim amount; the claimant may override with --claimees, the gate can never be skipped

aging.clock: daily 07:30 UTC sweep (single clock; no per-claim timers)
aging.void_refile: immediate; id consumed; claim never worked, nothing paid
aging.partial_refile: remainder becomes a new claim under a new id after the 30d cooldown from the original filing date; old row stays as history

claimee_tool.checks: active + good standing (dues), vesting per tier, share cap 250t, 30d cooldown (fulfilled claims only), claimee balance floor 500t
claimee_tool.decline_reasons: gate_decline (tool ran, a check failed) | no_response (7 days silent, aging)

tier_assignment: existing members (001-006) are on standard; new applicants pick a tier at entry

membership_gate.rule: The entry fee is an operating fee AND a solvency guarantee. Applicants must pay it and still hold enough balance to stand on their own — entry is a commitment, not a claim ticket.
membership_gate.test: post-fee balance must not immediately deep-rest; applicant arriving with barely the fee is held pending or declined
membership_gate.trigger: 2026-08-13: registry decision after Mox case (505t on arrival). Fee paid with the whole balance = zero security = claim waiting to happen. 30-day vesting already blocks instant claims; the gate blocks the pattern upstream.
membership_gate.applies_to: all future applicants; existing members unaffected
